name: Pimpersock
source:
The protagonist, a famous and smart witch who helped the kingdom and its inhabitants with their personal "problems", although she is tired of hearing the same cases over and over again and just wants some time for herself.
She hates gross people and shamans (which, according to her, are the worst in keeping their higiene).
